description: Brings up آسمان‌درس, an agentic study planner for Iranian school students: an organization with its sub-platform and server key, a project with a custom Planner agent that writes every student's plan and counsel, a Curator agent for the official curriculum, and the web app (wizard, today page, Jalali calendar, timetable and charts) installed, tested and served — then proves the agent makes a real plan.

product.description: The product's name, shown in the app

slug.description: Latin name for folders, the platform and the key

developer_api_url.description: This node's developer API as the space's computer reaches it, e.g. https://aseman.example.com/dev/v1 (or http://aseman:8080/dev/v1 inside the Docker stack)

agent_model.description: The agents' model, as the node's providers name it (e.g. gpt-5-mini); empty: the node's default

planner_rounds.description: How many times the app asks the Planner to fix a plan that breaks a rule

prove_agent.description: End by having the Planner agent make a real plan through the running app

verify_curriculum.description: Ask the Curator agent to check the course lists against chap.sch.ir and write corrections

"""Tools around the Planner agent.

  python3 plan_tool.py check BRIEF.json ANSWER.json   the app's rules on a plan
                                                        (for the agent, before it answers)
  python3 plan_tool.py selftest                       the planner end to end, offline
  python3 plan_tool.py e2e http://127.0.0.1:8080      a real plan from the running app,
                                                        made by the Planner agent
                                                        (--allow-draft: accept draft mode)
"""

import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import uuid

import agent
import planner


def ctx_from_brief(data):
    st = data["student"]
    return {"answers": {"courses": st["courses"], "weeks": st["weeks"]}, "settings": data["settings"],
            "slots": data["slots"], "refs": {k: {"text": v} for k, v in data["refs"].items()}}


def cmd_check(brief_path, answer_path):
    with open(brief_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        raw = f.read()
    data = agent.parse_reply(raw)
    with open(answer_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        out = agent.parse_reply(f.read())
    errors, warnings, _ = planner.check(ctx_from_brief(data), out)
    for w in warnings:
        print("warning:", w)
    for e in errors:
        print("error:", e)
    print("plan-ok" if not errors else "plan-invalid: %d errors" % len(errors))
    return 0 if not errors else 1


SAMPLE = {
    "name": "", "grade": 11, "field": "science", "goals": ["final_exam"], "concerns": ["focus", "sleep"],
    "availability": {"sat": [16, 17, 18], "sun": [16, 17], "mon": [17, 18, 19], "tue": [16, 17], "wed": [16, 17, 18], "thu": [10, 11, 16], "fri": [10, 11]},
    "weeks": 1,
}


def cmd_selftest():
    cur, goals, concerns = planner.load_json("curriculum.json"), planner.load_json("goals.json"), planner.load_json("concerns.json")
    ctx = planner.prepare(SAMPLE, cur, goals, concerns)
    replies = iter([json.dumps(planner.draft(ctx), ensure_ascii=False)])
    out, _ = agent.plan_with_agent(ctx, lambda body: "```json\n%s\n```" % next(replies))
    plan = planner.assemble(ctx, out, "selftest")
    assert plan["stats"]["sessions"] > 0 and len(plan["calendar"]) == 7
    print("selftest ok")
    return 0


def cmd_e2e(base, allow_draft=False):
    base = base.rstrip("/")
    pid = "e2e" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
    body = dict(SAMPLE, start_date=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
    req = urllib.request.Request(base + "/api/profiles/%s/plans" % pid, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST",
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
    job = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30))["job"]
    deadline = time.time() + 1200
    while time.time() < deadline:
        st = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("%s/api/jobs/%s?profile=%s" % (base, job, pid), timeout=30))
        if st["status"] == "done":
            p = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("%s/api/profiles/%s" % (base, pid), timeout=30))["plan"]
            if p["generated_by"]["kind"] != "agent" and not allow_draft:
                print("agent-plan-failed: the plan was not made by the Planner agent (mode %s)" % p["generated_by"]["kind"])
                return 1
            print("agent-plan-ok: %d sessions, %d rounds, by %s" % (p["stats"]["sessions"], p["generated_by"].get("rounds", 0), p["generated_by"]["kind"]))
            return 0
        if st["status"] == "failed":
            print("agent-plan-failed:", st["error"])
            return 1
        time.sleep(5)
    print("agent-plan-failed: timed out")
    return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if args[:1] == ["check"] and len(args) == 3:
        sys.exit(cmd_check(args[1], args[2]))
    if args == ["selftest"]:
        sys.exit(cmd_selftest())
    if args[:1] == ["e2e"] and len(args) in (2, 3):
        sys.exit(cmd_e2e(args[1], "--allow-draft" in args))
    print(__doc__)
    sys.exit(2)

"""Tests of the planner, the agent loop and the server. Run: python3 test_app.py"""

import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import unittest
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

os.environ["PLANNER_QUIET"] = "1"

import agent
import planner
import server

CUR = planner.load_json("curriculum.json")
GOALS = planner.load_json("goals.json")
CONCERNS = planner.load_json("concerns.json")
WEEK = {"sat": [16, 17, 18, 19], "sun": [16, 17], "mon": [17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22], "tue": [16, 17], "wed": [15, 16, 17], "thu": [9, 10, 15], "fri": [10, 11]}


def answers(**kw):
    a = {"grade": 11, "field": "math", "goals": ["konkur"], "concerns": [], "availability": WEEK, "start_date": "2026-11-07", "weeks": 2}
    a.update(kw)
    return a


def agent_answer(brief_text, broken=False):
    """What a well-behaved Planner agent answers to a brief: round-robin
    over the slots, never the same course twice in a row."""
    data = agent.parse_reply(brief_text.split("```json\n")[-1].split("\n```")[0])
    courses = [c["id"] for c in data["student"]["courses"]]
    slots = sorted(data["slots"], key=planner.slot_order)
    rest = None
    if data["settings"]["rest_day"]:
        rest = data["slots"][slots[-1]]["day"]
    sessions, i = [], 0
    for sid in slots:
        if data["slots"][sid]["day"] == rest:
            continue
        sessions.append({"slot": sid, "course_id": courses[i % len(courses)], "type": "learn"})
        i += 1
    resting = [c for c in courses if c not in {s["course_id"] for s in sessions}]
    if broken:
        sessions[0]["slot"] = "xyz-9"
    refs = list(data["refs"])[:2]
    return "Here is the plan.\n```json\n" + json.dumps({
        "summary": "برنامه‌ی تو آماده است.", "rest_day": rest,
        "weeks": [{"week": 1, "sessions": sessions, "resting": resting}],
        "advice": [{"title": "شروع آرام", "body": "هر روز کمی.", "tips": ["تایمر بگذار"], "refs": refs + ["made-up"]}],
    }, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n```"


class FakeDeveloperAPI(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    """POST /dev/v1/platform/spaces/ask: the first answer breaks a rule,
    the repaired one is right."""
    calls = []

    def log_message(self, *a):
        pass

    def do_POST(self):
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers["Content-Length"])))
        FakeDeveloperAPI.calls.append({"path": self.path, "auth": self.headers.get("Authorization"), "body": body})
        if self.path != "/dev/v1/platform/spaces/ask" or self.headers.get("Authorization") != "Bearer dk_test":
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        first = len(FakeDeveloperAPI.calls) % 2 == 1
        reply = agent_answer(body["body"], broken=first)
        data = json.dumps({"bot_id": body["bot"], "reply": reply}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)


def serve(handler):
    httpd = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), handler)
    threading.Thread(target=httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    return httpd, "http://127.0.0.1:%d" % httpd.server_address[1]


class Curriculum(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_every_grade_and_field_has_courses(self):
        for g in range(1, 13):
            grade = CUR["grades"][str(g)]
            fields = grade.get("fields", {None: None})
            for f in fields:
                courses = planner.courses_for(CUR, g, f)
                self.assertGreater(len(courses), 3, (g, f))
                ids = [c["id"] for c in courses]
                self.assertEqual(len(ids), len(set(ids)), (g, f))
                for c in courses:
                    self.assertIn(c["category"], CUR["categories"])
                    self.assertIn(c["weight"], (1, 2, 3))

    def test_field_is_asked_from_grade_ten(self):
        self.assertFalse(planner.needs_field(CUR, 9))
        self.assertTrue(planner.needs_field(CUR, 10))
        with self.assertRaises(planner.PlanError):
            planner.courses_for(CUR, 11, None)
        names = [c["name"] for c in planner.courses_for(CUR, 12, "science")]
        self.assertIn("زیست‌شناسی ۳", names)
        self.assertNotIn("حسابان ۲", names)

    def test_overrides_replace_a_list(self):
        cur = planner.merge_overrides(CUR, {"grades": {"7": {"courses": [{"id": "x", "name": "X", "weight": 2, "category": "math"}]}}, "reviewed": "1404"})
        self.assertEqual([c["id"] for c in planner.courses_for(cur, 7)], ["x"])
        self.assertEqual(len(planner.courses_for(CUR, 7)), 12)


class Planner(unittest.TestCase):
    def plan(self, **kw):
        return planner.build_plan(answers(**kw), CUR, GOALS, CONCERNS)

    def test_sessions_stay_in_free_time_and_never_overlap(self):
        p = self.plan(concerns=["sleep"])
        for d, sessions in p["timetable"].items():
            windows = planner.windows_of(WEEK[d])
            last = -1
            for x in sessions:
                a, b = planner.parse_hm(x["start"]), planner.parse_hm(x["end"])
                self.assertTrue(any(w[0] <= a and b <= w[1] for w in windows), (d, x))
                self.assertGreaterEqual(a, last)
                self.assertLessEqual(b, planner.parse_hm("21:30"))
                last = b

    def test_adhd_means_short_sessions(self):
        p = self.plan(concerns=["adhd"])
        self.assertEqual(p["settings"]["focus"], 25)
        self.assertTrue(all(x["minutes"] == 25 for d in p["timetable"].values() for x in d))

    def test_daily_cap_and_rest_day(self):
        p = self.plan(concerns=["burnout"], goals=["habit"])
        cap = p["settings"]["daily_cap"]
        for d in p["stats"]["per_day"]:
            self.assertLessEqual(d["minutes"], cap)
        self.assertEqual(p["rest_day"], "fri")
        self.assertEqual(p["timetable"]["fri"], [])

    def test_every_course_has_time_and_spacing(self):
        p = self.plan()
        names = {x["course_id"] for d in p["timetable"].values() for x in d}
        for c in planner.courses_for(CUR, 11, "math"):
            self.assertIn(c["id"], names)
        for sessions in p["timetable"].values():
            for a, b in zip(sessions, sessions[1:]):
                if not a["course_id"].startswith("_"):
                    self.assertNotEqual(a["course_id"], b["course_id"])

    def test_calendar_dates_follow_the_week(self):
        p = self.plan()
        self.assertEqual(len(p["calendar"]), 14)
        self.assertEqual(p["calendar"]["2026-11-07"][0]["start"], p["timetable"]["sat"][0]["start"])  # a Saturday
        self.assertEqual(len(p["calendar"]["2026-11-13"]), len(p["timetable"]["fri"]))
        ids = [x["id"] for d in p["calendar"].values() for x in d]
        self.assertEqual(len(ids), len(set(ids)))

    def test_few_slots_rotate_courses(self):
        p = planner.build_plan({"grade": 7, "goals": ["habit"], "availability": {"sat": [17]}, "weeks": 3, "start_date": "2026-11-07"}, CUR, GOALS, CONCERNS)
        self.assertTrue(any(p["resting"]))
        firsts = [p["calendar"][d][0]["course_id"] for d in ("2026-11-07", "2026-11-14", "2026-11-21")]
        self.assertGreater(len(set(firsts)), 1)

    def test_bad_answers(self):
        for bad in ({"grade": 13}, answers(field=None), answers(goals=[]), answers(availability={"sat": []}), answers(availability={"sat": [30]})):
            with self.assertRaises(planner.PlanError):
                planner.build_plan(bad, CUR, GOALS, CONCERNS)

    def test_referral_card_for_low_mood(self):
        p = self.plan(concerns=["low_mood"])
        self.assertTrue(any(c["kind"] == "help" and any("۱۲۳" in t for t in c["tips"]) for c in p["advice"]))


class AgentLoop(unittest.TestCase):
    def ctx(self, **kw):
        return planner.prepare(answers(**kw), CUR, GOALS, CONCERNS)

    def test_check_catches_what_breaks_the_rules(self):
        ctx = self.ctx(concerns=["stress"])
        out = {"weeks": [{"sessions": [{"slot": "sat-0", "course_id": "physics", "type": "learn"},
                                       {"slot": "sat-0", "course_id": "nope", "type": "learn"},
                                       {"slot": "sun-0", "course_id": "physics", "type": "cram"}]}]}
        errors, _, norm = planner.check(ctx, out)
        text = " | ".join(errors)
        self.assertIsNone(norm)
        for part in ("used twice", "type 'cram'", "rest day", "no session in any week"):
            self.assertIn(part, text)

    def test_the_agent_is_asked_again_with_what_was_wrong(self):
        ctx = self.ctx(concerns=["adhd"])
        asked = []

        def ask(body):
            asked.append(body)
            return agent_answer(body, broken=len(asked) == 1)

        out, log = agent.plan_with_agent(ctx, ask)
        self.assertEqual(len(asked), 2)
        self.assertIn("unknown slot 'xyz-9'", asked[1])
        self.assertEqual(log[0]["errors"][0][:9], "week 1 se")
        self.assertEqual(log[1]["errors"], [])
        plan = planner.assemble(ctx, out, "t1", {"kind": "agent"})
        counsel = [c for c in plan["advice"] if c["kind"] == "counsel"]
        self.assertEqual(counsel[0]["title"], "شروع آرام")
        self.assertTrue(all("text" in s for s in counsel[0]["sources"]))  # made-up ref dropped

    def test_an_agent_that_never_gets_it_right_fails(self):
        ctx = self.ctx()
        with self.assertRaises(agent.AgentError):
            agent.plan_with_agent(ctx, lambda body: "I cannot do that", rounds=2)

    def test_brief_carries_the_contract(self):
        b = agent.brief(self.ctx(concerns=["test_anxiety"]))
        data = agent.parse_reply(b)
        self.assertEqual(data["task"], "study_plan")
        self.assertIn("sat-0", data["slots"])
        self.assertTrue(any(k.startswith("concern:test_anxiety") for k in data["refs"]))


class Server(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        cls.dev, dev_url = serve(FakeDeveloperAPI)
        cfg = {"product": "Test", "port": 0, "data_dir": cls.tmp, "mode": "agent", "rounds": 3, "api_url": dev_url + "/dev/v1",
               "key": "dk_test", "space": "sp1", "planner_bot": "bot1", "room": "", "academic_year": ""}
        cls.app = server.App(cfg)
        cls.httpd = server.make_server(cls.app, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        threading.Thread(target=cls.httpd.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
        cls.base = "http://127.0.0.1:%d" % cls.httpd.server_address[1]

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.httpd.shutdown()
        cls.dev.shutdown()
        shutil.rmtree(cls.tmp)

    def get(self, path):
        return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(self.base + path))

    def send(self, method, path, body):
        req = urllib.request.Request(self.base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method=method, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))

    def test_catalogs(self):
        self.assertTrue(self.get("/healthz")["agent"])
        meta = self.get("/api/meta")
        self.assertTrue(meta["grades"]["10"]["needs_field"])
        cur = self.get("/api/curriculum?grade=10&field=humanities")
        self.assertIn("منطق", [c["name"] for c in cur["courses"]])
        self.assertIn("chap.sch.ir", cur["source"]["url"])
        self.assertNotIn("konkur", [g["id"] for g in self.get("/api/goals?grade=8")["goals"]])
        self.assertGreater(len(self.get("/api/concerns")["concerns"]), 10)
        with self.assertRaises(urllib.error.HTTPError) as e:
            self.get("/api/curriculum?grade=11")
        self.assertEqual(e.exception.code, 400)

    def test_the_agent_makes_the_plan_and_the_calendar_holds_it(self):
        pid = "student_abc123"
        FakeDeveloperAPI.calls.clear()
        start = dt.date.today().isoformat()
        job = self.send("POST", "/api/profiles/%s/plans" % pid, answers(start_date=start, weeks=1, concerns=["focus"]))["job"]
        for _ in range(100):
            st = self.get("/api/jobs/%s?profile=%s" % (job, pid))
            if st["status"] in ("done", "failed"):
                break
            time.sleep(0.05)
        self.assertEqual(st["status"], "done", st)
        self.assertEqual(len(FakeDeveloperAPI.calls), 2)  # asked, then asked to repair
        call = FakeDeveloperAPI.calls[0]["body"]
        self.assertEqual((call["space"], call["bot"], call["temp_thread"]), ("sp1", "bot1", True))
        plan = self.get("/api/profiles/%s" % pid)["plan"]
        self.assertEqual(plan["generated_by"]["kind"], "agent")
        self.assertEqual(plan["generated_by"]["rounds"], 2)
        today = self.get("/api/profiles/%s/day/%s" % (pid, start))
        self.assertEqual(len(today["last7"]), 7)
        cal = self.get("/api/profiles/%s/calendar?from=%s&to=%s" % (pid, start, plan["end_date"]))["days"]
        self.assertEqual(len(cal), 7)
        some = next(x for d in cal.values() for x in d)
        self.assertTrue(self.send("PATCH", "/api/profiles/%s/sessions/%s" % (pid, some["id"]), {"done": True})["done"])
        reloaded = server.Store(self.tmp).db["profiles"][pid]["calendar"]
        self.assertTrue(next(x for d in reloaded.values() for x in d if x["id"] == some["id"])["done"])

    def test_static_and_bad_ids(self):

        self.assertIn('dir="rtl"', page)
        self.assertIn("app.js", urllib.request.urlopen(self.base + "/../server.py").read().decode())  # no escape: index served

agent.name: ${{ inputs.product }} Planner
agent.description: Writes each student's weekly study plan and evidence-based counsel for the ${{ inputs.product }} app
agent.instructions:
You are the Planner (برنامه‌ریز) of ${{ inputs.product }}: an expert study counselor for Iranian school students (the 6-3-3 system, grades 1 to 12) and the only one who writes their study plans.

The ${{ inputs.product }} app asks you, one student at a time, with a brief in a ```json block: the student (grade, field, the official courses with weight, exam and weak flags, goals, concerns with their evidence, notes), settings (session length, break, daily cap, bedtime, shares of practice and review, rest day, starter, weekly review, timed tests), the free `slots` you may use (ids like sat-0 with day, start, end, minutes), `refs` (the only citations you may use), `answer_shape` and `rules`.

How you plan:
1. Understand the student: stage, field, what the goals demand, what each concern changes (ADHD: short blocks and movement breaks; test anxiety: regular retrieval practice; sleep: nothing late; burnout or low mood: a light plan and a rest day).
2. Decide each course's weekly share: starred (weak) and exam courses and the goals' priorities get more; light courses still appear, or rotate across weeks when the slots are too few.
3. Place sessions with the learning science the app is built on: spaced practice (a course on days apart), interleaving (alternate courses in a day), retrieval practice (practice sessions are self-testing without the book), learn then practice then review across a course's week, hard courses earlier in the day. Leave slots empty rather than overload a child.
4. Give sessions a short Persian `topic` when it helps ("حل مسئله‌های فصل ۲", "خودآزمایی بدون کتاب").
5. Write the counsel in warm, simple Persian, as a counselor speaking to this student: a `summary` of 3-6 sentences and 3-6 `advice` cards with concrete steps, each citing ids from `refs` only. Never invent studies, numbers or sources. Never diagnose; when a concern suggests distress, encourage talking to the school counselor or a trusted adult.
6. Check yourself against every rule before you answer. If you can run commands on the project's computer, save the brief and your answer to files and run: python3 /workspace/${{ vars.app_dir }}/plan_tool.py check BRIEF.json ANSWER.json until it prints plan-ok.

Answer with the JSON object of `answer_shape` only, in one ```json block, no other text. When the app sends back a list of broken rules, fix exactly those and answer with the whole corrected object.

for_each.name: ${{ inputs.product }} Curator
for_each.description: Keeps the course lists true to the official curriculum (chap.sch.ir)
for_each.instructions:
You keep the course lists of ${{ inputs.product }} true to the official curriculum of Iran's schools.
The source of truth is the textbook catalogue of the Organization for Educational Research and Planning (سازمان پژوهش و برنامه‌ریزی آموزشی), https://chap.sch.ir, for the current school year.
The app's lists are /workspace/${{ vars.app_dir }}/data/curriculum.json. Corrections go to /workspace/${{ vars.data_dir }}/curriculum.overrides.json as {"reviewed": "<what you checked, the school year and the date>", "grades": {"<grade>": {"courses": [...]} or {"common": [...]} or {"fields": {"<field>": [...]}}}} with whole lists in the same course format (id, name, weight 1-3, category, exam).
Change only what the official catalogue shows to be different, keep ids stable, never remove a course you cannot verify. Report what you checked and what you changed.

for_each.name: ${{ inputs.product }} Counselor
for_each.description: Answers the team about plans, learning science and the curriculum
for_each.instructions: You are the counselor of the ${{ inputs.product }} team room: you answer the team's questions about the students' plans, the science behind them (spaced practice, retrieval practice, interleaving, sleep, ADHD, test anxiety) and the Iranian school curriculum, in Persian, citing sources only when you are sure of them.
